name: Tuneshine
author: daviidpaark
description: Sends album art and track metadata to a Tuneshine device or Tuneshine Hub

users.reason: To receive scrobble and now-playing events for all users

http.reason: To send album art and metadata to the Tuneshine device or hub

cache.reason: To deduplicate requests and avoid sending duplicate artwork

scheduler.reason: To debounce pause events and prevent screen flickering during seeks, track transitions, and player reconnects

subsonicapi.reason: To fetch track artwork for sending to the Tuneshine device or hub

mode.title: Operation Mode
mode.description: Direct to Device performs all 64x64 WebP conversion on Navidrome. Tuneshine Hub offloads image processing and debouncing to a dedicated Hub container.

host.title: Target Host
host.description: In Direct mode: IP or hostname of your physical Tuneshine (e.g. 192.168.1.100 or tuneshine.local). In Hub mode: IP or hostname of Tuneshine Hub (e.g. tuneshine-hub:8585 or 192.168.1.100:8585).

servicename.title: Service Name
servicename.description: Name shown on the Tuneshine as the music source

user.title: Restrict to User(s)
user.description: Optional. Comma-separated list of Navidrome usernames allowed to update the display (e.g. "user1" or "user1,user2"). Leave blank to allow all users.
